note: One frame answers the first INFO, as the web's _send_handshake writes it: CONNECT with the socket token, both order subjects (equity sid 1, F&O sid 2), PING.

Groww answers the detail read with a refusal: the push's own fields stay. Its symbol is the ISIN the push names (the master has none), and no price is reported, since the push's integer prices have no stated unit.
No answer at all for this order's detail (404): the push's F&O contract maps through the master, and its remark is the rejection reason.
The one read of the unanswered detail, as the web makes it.
